body.voice_description: Create an original cartoon chess-coach voice. Character: Literal robot chess coach. Must sound unmistakably mechanical, not merely a human speaking flatly. Issue, cause, result; no beep-boop jokes. Voice direction: Very low metallic resonant robotic voice, bounded pitch steps, firm labeled pauses and a steady mechanical cadence. Audible synthetic vocal harmonics, not just a stern human bass. No growling, distortion bursts or sound effects. Fluent spoken English, with the requested accent. Normal conversational pace with clear teaching emphasis; aim for an eight-to-ten-second passage without long dramatic pauses. Clean, dry studio recording, one intelligible voice, no music, background noise or animal sounds. Finish the final word completely with a natural settled ending. An original character voice, not an imitation of a named person or existing character.
body.text: Issue: unguarded piece. Cause: its defender has moved. Result: the opponent can capture it. Check the reply before committing to the move.

encoding.method: SoundFile float64 decode; arithmetic channel mean; band-limited FFT resample to 48000 Hz; libsndfile Ogg Opus at compression level 0.93
